# Maintained native backports

VOCO vendors narrow patches for [glib](glib/VOCO-PATCH.md),
[global-hotkey](global-hotkey/VOCO-PATCH.md) and
[tray-icon](tray-icon/VOCO-PATCH.md). Their source inventories and provenance checks
remain alongside the corresponding dependency. Speech recognition uses the pinned
[Nemotron runtime](../runtime/native/README.md); no second recognizer is compiled
into the application.
